characters.name: Riffin
characters.silhouetteAnchor: oversized ears and a long guitar-neck tail
characters.anatomyInvariant: The round cream soundboard forms the belly; exactly three horizontal strings cross the body and flow into one long tail that curves upward as the neck, ending in exactly three pegs.
characters.avoid: No vertical torso strings, straight separate neck, separate guitar, extra strings, extra tuning pegs, or egg.

characters.name: Boppo
characters.silhouetteAnchor: raised frog eyes, bent legs, and a round drum belly
characters.anatomyInvariant: The broad cream drum membrane is the belly and rhythm reads through the body pose.
characters.avoid: No separate drum, sticks, mallets, or egg.

characters.name: Chordillo
characters.silhouetteAnchor: upright ears and a large banded armadillo shell
characters.anatomyInvariant: Alternating shell bands suggest neighboring chord tones while remaining armadillo armor.
characters.avoid: No separate keyboard, xylophone, percussion bars, or egg.

characters.name: Ringlet
characters.silhouetteAnchor: two uneven listening ears over a bell-shaped torso
characters.anatomyInvariant: The lower torso is one flared handbell; one small flat clapper is recessed high inside its dark opening and never hangs below the rim or between the feet; one ear tips forward to listen.
characters.avoid: No carried bell, separate handle, second clapper, spherical clapper, pendant, or dangling shape between the legs.

characters.name: Brumbo
characters.silhouetteAnchor: wide ears and one curled bell-ended trunk
characters.anatomyInvariant: The trunk itself widens into one polished trumpet bell.
characters.avoid: No separate trumpet, mouthpiece, tusks, or loose brass parts.

characters.name: Plinka
characters.silhouetteAnchor: one fan of softly rounded graded tine-spines
characters.anatomyInvariant: The playable graded tines are the hedgehog spines themselves and form the entire back silhouette.
characters.avoid: No attached kalimba rack, hardware, ordinary quill layer, sharp spikes, or separate instrument.

characters.name: Puffino
characters.silhouetteAnchor: upright puffin oval with a beak and horizontal bellows
characters.anatomyInvariant: A compact accordion spans horizontally across the visible rounded torso with symmetrical end plates.
characters.avoid: No detached, dangling, vertical, beard-like, or chest-obscuring accordion.

characters.name: Cymbi
characters.silhouetteAnchor: round ladybug body with paired golden dorsal discs
characters.anatomyInvariant: Exactly two cymbal discs form the wing covers on the back above a plain front torso; six small feet remain visible.
characters.avoid: No front-mounted cymbals, chest discs, extra cymbals, human torso anatomy, or missing feet.

characters.name: Spirlo
characters.silhouetteAnchor: low snail profile with a coiled horn shell and rear bell
characters.anatomyInvariant: Exactly one pair of eyes sits at the tips of exactly two stalks; the shell is coiled brass tubing ending in one backward flared bell.
characters.avoid: No second eye pair, face eyes, separate horn, racing joke, or chord-shell bands.
